news.title: Source: Mets agree to 1-year deal with veteran 1B Goldschmidt
news.summary: The New York Mets continued their spending spree Monday by coming to terms on a one-year deal with first baseman Paul Goldschmidt, a source told ESPN, a day after agreeing to give Tarik Skubal the lar...

news.title: Big Apple blockbuster: Mets, Skubal reach record 9-year, $450M contract, sources say
news.summary: Tarik Skubal and the Mets agreed to a nine-year, $450 million contract, sources told ESPN. It is the richest deal for a pitcher, both by total and average annual value.

news.title: Sources: Tigers stay busy, add '24 AL Rookie of Year Gil to pitching mix
news.summary: Luis Gil and the Tigers are in agreement on a one-year, $2.3 million contract, sources told ESPN, as he lands a job just days after the Yankees nontendered him.

news.title: Mets, CF Ewing agree on 8-year, $95M extension, sources say
news.summary: The Mets and 22-year-old center fielder A.J. Ewing have agreed to an eight-year, $95 million contract extension, sources confirmed to ESPN.

news.title: Dodgers acquire versatile infielder Lewis in trade with Twins
news.summary: The Dodgers acquired infielder Royce Lewis in a trade with the Twins, fulfilling Los Angeles' need for a versatile right-handed hitter to replace Miguel Rojas.

news.title: Sources: Tigers, right-hander Melton agree to 6-year, $46.5M extension
news.summary: Troy Melton, who went 8-5 with a 2.76 ERA in 20 starts this season, has agreed to a six-year, $46.5M contract extension with the Tigers, sources told ESPN.

news.title: Padres bring back slugger Sheets with 3-year deal
news.summary: Gavin Sheets is staying with the Padres after agreeing to a three-year contract, with sources telling ESPN the deal is worth $11 million.

news.title: Ohtani extends deal with New Balance for remainder of playing career
news.summary: Shohei Ohtani and New Balance have agreed to extend their contract through the remainder of the Dodgers superstar's playing career.
